title: Waterpik Ultra Waterflosser & Waterpik Cordless Plus Waterflosser Pack $89.98 Delivered @ Costco (Membership Required)
body:
Deal: Waterpik Ultra Waterflosser & Waterpik Cordless Plus Waterflosser Pack $89.98 Delivered @ Costco (Membership Required)

[Hugh G Rection] just floss, i use to use this religiously. Unfortunately, this blasts your gums away, and I don't even use a powerful setting. My dentist told me to stop using it.
Gum tissue does not naturally regenerate. If your gums have receded, they cannot grow back on their own.
[hamzie] hugh G's dentist here. I never said that
[G-Shock] It's only for old people with big gaps between their teeth. Probably seems good as people are lazy but as you say, just floss.
PS. You're not giving away our waterpik!
[Ez] He was crazy. His phone wasn't even hooked up.
[Roe Jogan] there is a surgery for that to fix them, its worth getting it overseas its cheaper
[Sfh1975] It doesnt really blast away your gums, unless you have some pre-existing condition perhaps. Besides, the pressure can be adjusted. Flossing is better, this is convenient, better than not flossing at all.
[Hugh G Rection] lol, not literally blast away your gums, but your gums will recede. I don't even use high pressure, but it is inevitable. To dislodge food, you will be hitting your gums.
[FallaM] How does this even receive upvoting? What the hell does "blasting your gums away" even mean? How is pulling microplastics through your teeth any better? Gums can't be blasted away like scum on pavement with a power washer
[Hugh G Rection] lol, is it safe to assume you don't own one?
You can't use the water pick at a low pressure, or else you could just save your money and just swish water around in your mouth.
To get into the gaps, you will be hitting your gum line, and over time, it will recede.
I go for my dental checkup every 6 months for my perfect teeth, and she noticed my gums were receding, and she doesn't recommend Waterpiks.
I also think that is why FB marketplace is flooded with used waterpiks.
[noren7] this look soooo bulky
have a amazon (travel sized and I just use in the shower - from dentist recommendation) one I got for maybe 25 bucks and it's working well and my dentist is happy
[noren7] I got this one on sale for $28 and it's been great. I fill it up in the shower twice and use it, gets all wet and doesn't matter as it's waterproof https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B0DQKL3LB8
[YoursTruly] cheers 👍
Fragile, or falls apart easily?
[AustriaBargain] I've tried a few portable ones and find Waterpik is the best. The popular Chinese ones are great, except they aren't waterproof so they break quickly, so you can't use it under a running shower. The Colgate popup style one used for a lot of different brands is kinda flimsy. The Waterpik one is properly waterproof with mechanical power switch.
[1d0ntkn0w] I feel like a broken record but ~$77 via doordash though would need to buy something else to reach $100 min spend for free delivery.
[Oneiricer] Showing up as $98 for me in doordash. Got a link?
[1d0ntkn0w] This is via 20% off doordash gift cards from Costco. On the price, have you put your Costco membership into doordash? Not sure if you can send a link to a doordash item but here is a screenshot of it . It should show up as ~$93 and you get 17% off after fees (assuming you spend over $100 and don't get hit with a delivery charge)
[placard] I asked my dentist what they thought of these when I had a checkup recently. They said they are good for those people who don't floss normally, but it's more effective to use the floss.
[Bargainendorphins] My dentist recommended I use one of these. I do now and it removes so much more than flossing for me. Much softer on my gums than floss too.
[UltimateAI] My teeth are quite close, floss always gets stuck. Have been using a similar product (Philips) for years and has worked well. No gum issues.
[petrichor] You can get a water flosser for a fraction of this price that attaches to your faucet and so has mains pressure behind it if you want it. You can use it to blast grout out from between tiles in shitty rentals. Anyway they're really effective just with a trickle running. There's a spot I can put it at the back of my mouth that cleans all the crap out of my tonsils.
